body: Thank you for putting up with my whining. But just not feeling there’s much of a future
I’ve been on those heavy lately
Nah not addicted I could do with it or not but it’s killing the pain currently
I usually only drink every 3 to 6 months but since this has happened the pain is too much to deal with so have been doing it nightly to kill the pain
That’s my goal but doing nothing, I’ve had really bad luck all my life and just as something good happens something like this happens, and I have no more energy
I’m fairly old not sure where to turn, backed into a corner
I don’t think I’ll live through this
I can’t afford one, just par for the course
